result.summary: This PR implements BIP 95 to introduce Testnet 5. It establishes chain parameters that enforce BIP 54 (Consensus Cleanup) starting from block 1, eliminates the 20-minute minimum-difficulty exception present in previous testnets, and raises the minimum difficulty threshold.
result.problem: Testnet 4 and prior testnets suffer from difficulty manipulation caused by the 20-minute minimum-difficulty rule, and lack a live test network running the proposed BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules from genesis.

result.card: PR #35861 implements BIP 95 to add Testnet 5, which eliminates the 20-minute minimum-difficulty exception seen in Testnet 4, raises minimum difficulty, and activates BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules from block 1. This provides developers and miners with a resilient testnet environment that also serves as a live proving ground for BIP 54. The PR rests on top of base PR #35793 and is currently in draft awaiting the merge of BIP 54, a mined genesis block, and seed infrastructure. It currently has no reviewer feedback, needs a rebase, and has failing CI.
